entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Priest and prophet exiled to Babylon (c. 593–571 BCE). His visions — including the chariot throne, the valley of dry bones, and the new Temple — provided hope to the exilic community and profoundly influenced apocalyptic and mystical traditions.
